proof_scope: two concurrent agents (A cover + B solver) answer a complex question end-to-end

claims.proves: Agent A selects a memory-recall-driven cover and speaks it (real Turbo render) WHILE Agent B works, then Embry speaks B's answer; concurrency and handoff ordering are proven by timestamps on real artifacts
claims.does_not_prove: full high-reasoning answer generation (Agent B's real solver is owned by embry-voice-control and stubbed here), or perceived voice quality

capability_claims.description: Agent A speaks a recall-driven cover concurrently while Agent B works; barge-in handoff order is correct; both lanes produce real wav artifacts.
Agent B produces the real high-reasoning answer to a complex question.

exemptions.justification: Agent B's real solver runtime lives in embry-voice-control and is not built yet; this harness uses a declared boundary_stub. Do not report full answer generation as proven here.

cases.name: two-agent-e2e-live
command: cd .. && python3 scripts/two_agent_e2e.py --question 'Why does the SC-7 control fail when CUI data crosses the boundary, and how should we harden it?' --output /mnt/storage12tb/skills/chatterbox-speak/outputs/two-agent-e2e.json --solver-delay 5 && cat /mnt/storage12tb/skills/chatterbox-speak/outputs/two-agent-e2e.json
